A friend was guiding me through the hiring process.

He and I worked in Singapore, when we traveled there to support the division.

The trip was nearly 24 hours in duration.

A 8700 mile journey usually taken in 3 segments.

We would typically traveled to SFO and fly to either Tokyo or Hong Kong.

Then fly to Singapore's Changi airport.

Arriving at the hotel around midnight.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

This was the second time that I had applied to this company.

The first time, made it far as the hiring manager.

The manager asked questions and I answered them satisfactorily.

So I thought.

Then I got rejected.

I couldn't figure out why.

Then few months later, a HR person contacted me and encouraged me to apply to a related role, but somewhat outside my comfort level.

This time, the company through my friend the hiring manager was guiding me through the process.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

I had to ask,

> How close was I to being hired last time I interviewed
>
> He said close, it was very close.

There are at least 2 things in life that are maddening because we don't know how close we came to getting.

One is a job and the other is dating that leads to courtship and marriage.

Accustomed to receiving nicely worded rejections.

Not knowing the real reason for denials.
